title: Jonathan Strange & Mr Norrell
author: Susanna Clarke
summary: In Regency England, magic has long been dead until two very different magicians bring it back: a dry, secretive scholar and a charming, impulsive rival. Their partnership and quarrel draw in the Napoleonic wars and a dangerous fairy presence.
readIf: you enjoy a long, funny, footnoted alternate history written in the voice of a Victorian novel.
skipIf: you want pace or modern language, as it is leisurely, dry and extremely long.

pairings.reason: Same author, a much shorter and stranger book with the same unusual, elegant approach to magic.
Another very English, comic take on the supernatural, though brisk and playful rather than stately.
The era's original social comedy, which this book gently echoes in its manners and dry humour.
